Event overview

We would like to invite you to join our Minor Surgery Skills | Entry Level (includes DOPS) course in England




This two-day course is highly recommended for beginners looking to learn the fundamentals of minor surgery skills.




The course has been specifically designed to ensure practitioners meet the requirements of the 2014 DES Minor Surgery Contract. It has been approved by NHS England and formulated in line with the latest NHS e-guidelines.




This highly practical and interactive course also includes the Direct Observations of Procedural Skills (DOPS) Assessment, which is required by NHS England for all GPs applying to practise minor surgery in England.




The course counts towards CPD and provides supporting information for revalidation. Participants will receive access to course presentations to aid learning, along with a certificate upon completion.




Our popular minor surgery courses use state-of-the-art models, instruments, and simulated tissues to provide full hands-on training alongside theoretical sessions.

Nestled near Euston Station at the junction of Euston Road and Melton Street, directly opposite the Wellcome Collection building, 30 Euston Square is easily accessible via various transportation modes.




Tube Euston Station via Northern, Victoria, and Overground lines, or Euston Square via Circle, Metropolitan, and Hammersmith and City lines.




Bus 18, 27, 30, 59, 68, 73, 91, 168, 205, 253, 390, 476.




Train Euston Station is a 1-minute walk, Kings Cross St Pancras is a 7-10 minute walk. Upon exiting Euston Station, head right towards Euston Square Underground station and University College Hospital. 




Car The nearest car park is George Mews Carpark on North Gower Street, NW1 2EU. For rates and opening hours please see here. The closest 24-hour car park is CitiPark on Clipstone Mews, W1W 5DG. For rates please see here.




Cycle storage available on site. Please ask Reception for assistance on arrival.
